name: rathus
description: Rathus Denmora (Fall from Heaven), a slim pale young man with spiky silver-white hair and blue eyes, a teal scarf, a long dark grey leather coat with brown belts and a round buckle, a tattered light grey cloak streaming behind him to the screen-left, a coil of rope with an iron grappling hook at his right hip, dark trousers and brown boots, a short straight steel sword in his LEFT hand (screen-right) held low and pointing down-right, his RIGHT hand (screen-left) an empty white-gloved fist
hands: the short sword stays in his left hand on the screen-right side and his right hand is an empty white-gloved fist on the screen-left side

strike.1: anticipation: weight shifts back onto the rear leg, torso leans back, the short sword is lifted up over the head with its tip pointing up and back, the tattered grey cloak swinging
strike.2: wind-up extreme: body coiled back and slightly crouched, the short sword cocked behind the head with the blade hanging down behind the shoulders, the empty right fist tucked in
strike.3: swing: the front foot steps toward the lower-right, the torso whips forward, the arm sweeps over the head and the short blade is level, pointing to the lower-right
strike.4: contact: sword arm fully extended toward the lower-right, the short blade slashing down-right, front knee bent, body low and leaning in, the empty right fist swung back for balance, the tattered cloak flaring out behind
strike.5: follow-through: the short blade carries on down until its tip nearly touches the ground at the lower-right, torso twisted, the silver hair and the tattered cloak trailing back
strike.6: recover: body rises, front foot pulls back halfway, the short sword comes back to its low ready angle, pointing down-right

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (the empty right fist flung out to the left, the sword arm thrown out to the right with the short sword pointing down), the tattered cloak whipping
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further, knees bent, the short sword dipping, the empty right fist still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back with the near foot, body thrown back, the sword arm flung up, the empty right hand drooping, the tattered cloak swirling
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, head droops, the short sword lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the tip of the short sword resting on the ground, the right arm hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the short sword slips out of the hand, legs slide forward
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left; the short sword lies on the ground at the lower-right; the tattered grey cloak spread under him
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the tattered cloak settles
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes closed, the short sword on the ground beside him, the coil of rope still at his hip
